decisions.decision: Added eslint-plugin-no-unsanitized@4.1.5 (exact pin) for XSS-sink detection (innerHTML/dangerouslySetInnerHTML/etc). Explicitly chose this over the generic eslint-plugin-security package.

decisions.decision: 01-23 fixed a real pre-existing bug: Checkbox's disabled:opacity-50/disabled:cursor-not-allowed used the CSS :disabled pseudo-class, which never matches Base UI's Checkbox.Root (renders a role=checkbox span + a separate hidden native input -- only the hidden input gets the real disabled attribute). Fixed to data-[disabled]:*.
decisions.rationale: Discovered live during 01-23's investigation task. Same class of bug flagged (unfixed) on Switch.tsx -- see blockers.

decisions.decision: 01-22 closed GC-13 (Button spinner reported as 'static') as working-as-designed, not a defect -- doc-only change. Live diagnostic confirmed no reduced-motion emulation was configured anywhere in this environment, so the spinner's computed animationName/animationPlayState were genuinely 'spin'/'running'.
decisions.rationale: The user's 'static' report was very likely their OS's prefers-reduced-motion accessibility setting doing exactly what button.tsx's motion-reduce:animate-none class was designed to respect.
